gaps.sentence: There's a growing ___ (AWARE) of mental health issues.
The new software ___ (ABLE) staff to work securely from anywhere.
gaps.explanation: 'Enable somebody to do something' — the present-tense verb fits the singular subject.

gaps.sentence: He's an ___ (ENTHUSIASM) supporter of the team.
The storm caused ___ (WIDE) damage along the coast.
gaps.explanation: 'Widespread damage' = damage across a large area.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (DEEP) of the lake is unknown.
gaps.explanation: 'Depth' — noun from deep (spelling change: deep → depth).

gaps.sentence: The delays have made the project far more ___ (COST) than planned.
gaps.explanation: 'Far more costly' — the comparative adjective is needed after 'more'.

gaps.sentence: The law was introduced to stop ___ (CHEAT) by companies.
